## History

As a young girl, Mary Joe had never seen anyone suffering from croup. While Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) was away, her baby daughter [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) fell severely ill with the disease. [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) was forced to seek emergency help at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), leaving Mary Joe behind as [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) stepped in to treat the baby through the night.
